note: The 400 square of the Glyph of each cell of the Grid of the Emoji page, rendered at 128 px in #80848E at an opacity of 0.7647. The glyphs of search, history, lock and chart are the ones of the Discord assets file (Z3PFMvgHo95bNq2IdAZNNr); mute is drawn in its style, with the knockout band of its slashed icons. The types of case (2026-11-27) take their glyphs from the Discord assets too, and the slashed ones are cut as Discord cuts a slashed icon: a band cut away between x + y = 333 and 467 of the 400 square and a slash 33 wide with round caps. The paperclip and the chain are mirrored, so the slash crosses them instead of running along them.
